2. Run workflow:test-a-business-model-one-belief-at-a-time with tools:run, tool tool:run-workflow-definition, input {row: "workflow:test-a-business-model-one-belief-at-a-time", pursuit, known}. Each step waits for an answer: its lines answered with evidence in checked, and the lines not answerable yet in open with what would answer them.
3. Answer a step by giving its answer under answers by its step id and running again; a line that names an existing workflow is answered by running that workflow.
4. Read what the run kept and what is open; the open lines are the next things to find out, and the last step names which part matters most next.
